evidence.quote: I like to define things by what they are not, so I want to say Software Factory is not just coding agent, and it's not even a swarm of coding agents, even thousands of agents, because generating code, writing code, that's the easy part compared to all the others.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: For example, if you write what it means to be done in the wrong way, the agent can try to pass your tests, but not really verify what you need to do and accomplish, but instead try to solve just passing your tests, so cheating by that.

entities.name: 模型路由 (routing)
entities.how_described: 本集讲 factory 的自动模型路由：先分类任务难度，设一个「够用」阈值，选阈值之上最便宜的模型；不只省钱，还带来速度和可靠性——一个提供商挂了自动切换，能省 25% 甚至更多。

evidence.quote: And the last thing that's really important topic is routing.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So smart routing between LLMs and just token optimizing between the LLMs instead of just spending so much tokens.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: We built a thing in factory called automatic model routing, and there's been a lot of questions around it, but what it does is it automatically routes between different models in your process.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: How the routing works, there are four parts.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: This is the magic of the routing.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 缓存 (caching)
entities.how_described: 本集说缓存可避免每次重复预填充上下文，是省钱的关键手段；开放模型在专用算力上托管也能享受缓存红利，把缓存折扣传导给用户只是定价决策而非技术挑战。

evidence.quote: How they did it, different tricks, like different default models for people, so stop pushing people to use only the frontier as a default, then caching, of course, to stop prefilling the stuff every time, and then no limits on spending, but just needing to see the results if you spend a lot.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And how do you handle caching?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 任务 (missions)
entities.how_described: 本集把 missions 描述为 factory 的智能体长时间运行会话：主智能体当编排者写下「完成意味着什么」的条件，派工作给工作者和验证者，循环迭代直到完成，能跑数周——一个真实客户任务运行了 16 小时，验证占 40%。

evidence.quote: Of course, that sounds ambitious, but for example, our missions already, our long-running sessions already build things and run for weeks.

evidence.quote: We have something called factory missions.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: We just call it missions because we send the agent to the mission.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And the missions work in the loop and iterating on task until it's done.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And this is how I visualized the missions.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: A lot of questions which are valid are like, how do you navigate the context bloat because you work on these long missions in the software factory, and how do you actually keep the context clean?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 验证 (validation)
entities.how_described: 本集强调验证是定义循环「完成」中最难的部分，占一个 16 小时真实任务的 40%；如果「完成」标准写得不好，智能体会靠通过测试来作弊。

evidence.quote: And just to see how important is the validation as well, it takes even 40% of the whole process.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: There is something from the orchestrator agent called validation contract that's written before any code is done.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 验证者 (validators)
entities.how_described: 本集说验证者评判自己没写过的代码，分两种：审查验证者严格检查代码库、linter、类型、测试；用户测试验证者则在自己的虚拟计算机里真的点击各种东西，确认产品能用而非只是好看。

evidence.quote: The main agent is orchestrator, and then it assigns work to workers' agents and then validators who review the task.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And validators, they review the output and provide feedback and send it back to the beginning.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Important thing is the validators judge code that they didn't write.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: kind of up to software factories where we manage these agents, as I said, orchestrator agents and workers and validators and all these teams, structured teams of agents that work really continuously in the loop and we just monitor and decide what to build.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 上下文膨胀 (context bloat)
entities.how_described: 本集说企业平均用几百种工具，工具的 schema 和描述会让智能体上下文膨胀、选错相似工具或填满上下文窗口被迫压缩丢信息；factory 用延迟上下文引擎逐步披露来应对，规模化能省 50% 以上 token。

evidence.quote: A lot of questions which are valid are like, how do you navigate the context bloat because you work on these long missions in the software factory, and how do you actually keep the context clean?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 计算机使用 (computer use)
entities.how_described: 本集说计算机使用和智能体持久虚拟机环境的进步，让验证者智能体能够真正进入「竞技场」，在虚拟计算机里点击产品确认它真的能用。

evidence.quote: I think this is one cool thing that was also allowed by the progress in computer use and the persistent environments, virtual machines for agents, which also wasn't here before or wasn't that great, but now it's really great, so it's allowing to go in the arena as an agent.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 开源模型 (open source models)
entities.how_described: 本集说开源模型通常更快，可在专用算力上托管并享受缓存红利，配合模型路由还能在一个提供商挂掉时自动切换到另一个。

evidence.quote: And important thing is it doesn't just help save money, it also helps with reliability or with speed because open source models are often faster and if one LN provider fails, you can just switch to another one automatically.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00
